record.one_liner: Per-seat B2B customer support platform (shared inbox, threads, help center) with GraphQL and REST APIs and an official MCP server.
record.auth_notes: Machine-user API keys with fine-grained permissions, created in Settings > Machine users & agents. OAuth app for calling the API as a workspace user. Official MCP server uses OAuth.
record.access_notes: 7-day free trial with no credit card required; API listed in the Developer platform row of every pricing tier (Foundation $45/user/mo, Horizon $99, Frontier custom) and blog says full API access on all plans. No free plan on pricing page. critic: confirmed self_serve_trial; no free plan found.
record.api_notes: Vendor says UI/API parity with no restrictive rate limits.

evidence.quote: A machine user can have several API keys, so you can rotate them without downtime.
To call the API as a user in your workspace, use an OAuth app.
7-day free trial, no credit card required.
Full API access and AI included on all plans.
GraphQL and REST APIs with full UI/API parity and no restrictive rate limits.
Plain MCP uses OAuth to allow your MCP server connection to share the same context as your normal web app user.
A machine user can have several API keys, so you can rotate them without downtime.
